title: Kubachi language
description: Northeast Caucasian language or dialect in Dagestan, Russia
extract: Kubachi is a language in the Dargin dialect continuum spoken in Dagestan, Russia, by Kubachi people. It is often considered a divergent dialect of Dargwa, but it has also historically been portrayed as a separate language. Ethnologue lists it as a separate language.
